Court okays 7 charges against 6 Netrakona 'Razakars'
2016-06-13T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/court-okays-7-charges-against-6-netrakona-razakars-1238752

International Crimes Tribunal-1 yesterday took into cognisance seven charges prosecutors pressed on May 22 against six Netrakona men, allegedly involved with Razakar Bahini, over crimes committed during the 1971 Liberation War.

The three-member tribunal led by Justice Anwarul Haque also directed the inspector general of police to submit a report on compliance with its arrest warrant against five of them and fixed June 28 to pass the next order.

All from Purbadhala upazila, Abdur Rahman, 70, is in jail while Sheikh Abdul Majid alias Majid Maulana, 66, Abdul Khaleque Talukder, 67, Kabir Khan, 70, Salam Begh, 68, and Nuruddin alias Raddin, 70, are on the run.

The charges include the killing of three Hindu men including prominent physician Hem Bagchi in Purbadhala Rajpara and looting of their houses in May; abduction and torture of Abdul Goni of Barha village on July 25; abduction and killing of Abdul Khaleque Talukder of Barha village and looting and torching of his house on August 21; abduction and killing of Mahir Uddin of Barha village on August 27; abduction of four people from Purbadhala upazila and killing of two of them between November 12 and 16; abduction and killing of Siraj Ali Mandal of Moudam village on November 20; and rape of a woman on November 25.
